interpretation: The adjacent lower-frequency level is usually materially slower than the base level, but it is not fixed at 2-3x: the observed T1/T0 median is about 3.71 with a broad 2.00-5.09 interquartile range.
The second lower-frequency level is again slower: T2/T1 median is about 3.08 and T2/T0 median is about 13.60.
This supports using measured hierarchical graphical levels rather than imposing a 2-3x filter band.
C1 is causally available often enough for a substantive A test. C2 is real but still sparse at live trade decision times, so B remains coverage-limited under its preregistered 20% fidelity gate.
The corrected C1 carrier passed its fidelity gate, so this is a materially better test than V1.
Nine-grid/slope/amplitude and internal shape improve pooled point estimates, but the A2 Brier improvement is about 0.88%, below the frozen 1% requirement, and the 97.5% block interval includes zero.
2019 worsens while 2018 and 2020 improve; the result therefore does not establish robust incremental prediction of C1 turns.
This rejects only the frozen minimal feature set as accepted predictive evidence on this consumed development sample; it does not prove that every possible small-wave morphology is uninformative.
The new mathematical carrier fixes the V1 zero-coverage failure and exposes real C1/C2 states, but the joint live-trade coverage is 18.20%, below the preregistered 20% fidelity threshold.

The descriptive direction is compatible with the financial hypothesis: C1-dominant trades have higher fast-loss and lower win rate than C2-dominant trades, but C2 samples are very small and the supportive subset has only two trades.
The incremental B1/B2 proper-score improvements are tiny and only 12 inference blocks are available, so the result cannot be treated as validated top-down routing evidence.
Do not relax the 20% gate after seeing the result. A future B study must first improve C2 causal availability by a separately preregistered representation change, not by outcome-driven retuning.

do_not: Do not call the measured level ratios fixed natural frequencies.
Do not claim A is predictive from favorable pooled point estimates.
Do not claim B is validated from the descriptive C1/C2 regime ordering.
Do not lower the frozen 20% B fidelity gate after observing 18.20% coverage.
Do not promote direction, publication, trade or production authority.
